differences.what: T-2579: the camera is re-fitted to six controls on Keith's own front (both pinnacle apexes, a third-storey jamb at head and sill, a bow light at head and sill): RMS 4.6 px, about 0.22 m at 58 m. Pinnacles, parapet, the upper lights and the bow head now register; what still differs is the building, below.
Flat top, south bow ending below the continuous third-storey arcade, and pierced parapet are present.
Fine carving, granite colour and lower details behind cars are below resolution or hidden. The demolished neighbours and later street are not the 1904 target.
The original is monochrome; granite colour is not shown. Sepia/scan casts are not material colour.

T-2581: the south face's front strip is built: coursed stone from grade to the parapet, 2.1 m behind the south-east pinnacle, where the model laid brick with toothed quoins; the photograph's strip runs on behind the pole at x 262, so this view bounds it from below and the mid-1950s view's downpipe sets its end.
T-2679: re-read after the crown changed: at this distance the band, the lattice head and the north-east boss are a few pixels and the picture cannot tell the old crown from the new.

T-2680: both front pinnacle apexes read within about 1 px of the lowered crown. Left of the south-east pier, the print shows dark coursed wall up to the coping's line (y 158), where the render's south side stops at y 182. The isolated render has no neighbours, so this is either Keith's south parapet or the house in front of it at 1812, and this distant view cannot say which.
T-2681: the loggia's columns 0.2 m taller and its balcony 0.3 m higher move it 4-6 px here, inside this camera's 4.6 px RMS; this view cannot tell the old heights from the new.
